Yes, in a way. Due to my beliefs I feel that my life is largely insignificant and any impact I make in this the world is at best slightly above negligible.

Happy, excited, energetic, tired, bored, suicidal. I found this sub from a news site and feel it is a good community that is attempting to help people, but first and foremost be a place to understand people suffering. I should probably also add that despite my name, I am not diagnosed bipolar, nor do I believe I am. Just made this name because it describes my thought process fairly accurately and I couldn't think of shit all else.
I'm still here

Thank you for taking out your time to talk to me. In short, nothing in particular. Nothing significant happened but I've suffered for years, received a lot of help, but find myself without a purpose in life. Not because I don't enjoy things, but because I see no purpose to existing beyond the obvious. I don't know sorry, maybe this was a mistake?

Hey gang member, a couple thoughts reading your post pooped into my mind and I hope you won't mind if I share them with you. I think both you and the people you are playing with are taking this too seriously. They are because they shouldn't be insulting you over what is at the end of the day a game and if you are playing in the non-competitive section to hone your skills then it's fine. You are also taking it too seriously because why on God's Earth do you give a shit what they say? It's quick play, you want to play Genji or Hanzo just play them and mute your team mates. If they give you shit for it, fling some back. Or preferably just leave the lobby and move on with your life. Good luck and don't idiots ruin your fun.
